newsitem.title: USA: Brothers Gourmet says volume trends up.
newsitem.headline: Brothers Gourmet says volume trends up.

text.p: Brothers Gourmet Coffees Inc said on Thursday that volume trends were improving and predicted that gross margins would improve during the year.

In a statement accompanying its first quarter earnings results, the company said that volume trends are now responding to the company's focus on the wholesale gourmet coffee business, noting that volume for the quarter was up 94 percent from a year ago.

"We have initiated a price increase, effective April 15, to absorb the latest increase in coffee cost and anticipate that gross margins will improve during the year," added company president and chief executive Donald Breen.

Brothers Gourmet posted a first quarter loss of $2.46 million, or $.22 per share from continuing operations, for the three months ended March 28, 1997, as compared to a loss of $412,000, $.04 per share, a year ago.

Breen added that although coffee costs had dropped considerably by this time last year, pricing still reflected previous increases taken to absorb high coffee costs caused by the 1994 Brazilian frost.
Brothers Gourmet Coffees Inc is a wholesale supplier of branded gourmet coffees.
